headlines.title_en: Goldman Sachs remains bullish on Japan's AI sector: Plunge presents buying opportunity
headlines.summary_en: Goldman Sachs said the sharp sell-off in Japan's AI-related stocks has created a buying opportunity, and believes strong earnings prospects could revive investor interest in semiconductor stocks. Goldman's chief Japan equity strategist Bruce Kirk said the pullback has lowered the bar for earnings to impress investors, leaving many AI-related stocks at levels where earnings beats could have a greater impact on share prices. 'As long as you don't think there will be a material deterioration in the geopolitical situation, current levels seem like a good time to add to certain positions. We don't think the AI story is over,' he said. Kirk expects investors to refocus on fundamentals. 'Ultimately, it all comes down to earnings,' he said. 'At much lower levels than late June, strong results should allow investors to refocus on the AI earnings story.' However, Kirk expects near-term volatility to remain.

headlines.title: Price of parenting: the household maths giving China’s consumers pause
headlines.summary:
Qiu Huiying, a human resources manager in Guangdong, worries in numerical terms when she looks ahead to the next decade: a 20-year mortgage, a 10 per cent loss on her property and thousands of yuan in monthly childcare costs that are set to rise.
She bought a 624 sq ft flat last year, so her mother-in-law could move in and help care for her son. But the purchase now feels less prudent after prices in the 20-year-old complex have already fallen by about 10 per cent.

headlines.summary_en: In European trading on Tuesday (July 28), the UK 10-year government bond yield fell 4.8 bps to 4.949%, declining throughout the session, trading in a range of 4.976%-4.945%, with a brief plunge after 23:00 Beijing time, nearing the daily low set at 16:48. The 2-year yield fell 5.3 bps to 4.328%. The 30-year yield fell 3.2 bps, and the 50-year yield fell 3.1 bps. The 2/10-year yield spread rose 0.384 bps to +61.725 bps.

headlines.summary: 【长鑫科技上市背后 产业新贵能否带火合肥楼市？】从合肥市区出发，经长江西路进入机场高速，再从长兴大道出口驶出，不多远即可到达空港集成电路配套产业园。7月27日，园区里的国产存储龙头企业长鑫科技登陆科创板。上市当日，长鑫科技涨幅为465.82%，收于49元/股，总市值3.28万亿元，问鼎A股市值榜首。资本的造富效应，令当地房企率先抢占先机。早在今年6月，就有房地产项目向长鑫科技员工推出“定向团购”，园区附近的房产中介也加大了推介力度。

headlines.title_en: CXMT listing: Can the new industry billionaire drive up Hefei's housing market?
headlines.summary_en: [Behind CXMT's Listing, Can the New Industry Giant Boost Hefei's Property Market?] Starting from downtown Hefei, take Changjiang West Road to the airport expressway, exit at Changxing Avenue, and soon reach the Airport Integrated Circuit Supporting Industrial Park. On July 27, CXMT, a domestic memory leader in the park, debuted on the STAR Market. On its first day, CXMT surged 465.82% to close at 49 yuan per share, with a total market cap of 3.28 trillion yuan, topping A-shares. The wealth effect from capital has led local developers to seize the opportunity. As early as June, a real estate project launched 'targeted group purchases' for CXMT employees, and property agents near the park have ramped up promotions.
